claim_rule: Only real_host or headless_extension_host evidence may support a host-runtime claim. mcp_protocol proves only transport/server behavior. static_schema proves only catalogue/template shape.

evidence_classes.real_host: The named released host binary or application spawned the managed wrapper in a disposable profile and completed the required MCP and project-identity cases.
evidence_classes.headless_extension_host: The named IDE extension ran in a disposable headless extension-host profile and completed the required MCP and project-identity cases; this is not evidence for the GUI shell.
evidence_classes.mcp_protocol: A synthetic MCP peer exercised wrapper startup, framing, tool discovery, and fail-closed cases without the named host.
evidence_classes.static_schema: Catalogue and adapter documents parsed and matched checked-in structural expectations; no process or MCP runtime was exercised.

combination_policy.rule: Expand every eligible host across both platform lanes and every provider profile. Record blocked and ineligible cells; never silently drop GUI, subscription, version, architecture, or provider-unavailable combinations.

provider_profiles.purpose: The host's approved real model/provider path, including subscription/account gates
Provider combination under an already accepted MCP-capable host; OpenRouter is never the host
Local model-runtime combination under an already accepted MCP-capable host; Ollama is never the host

darwin_arm64.environment: native macOS ARM64 disposable HOME/XDG profile

ubuntu_24_04_amd64_container.environment: Ubuntu 24.04 AMD64 Docker image with synthetic mounted fixtures only
ubuntu_24_04_amd64_container.limitation: A container cannot certify a native desktop GUI host.

hosts.observed_real_host_case: Three standalone CLI observations, the retained Desktop no-cwd rejection, and exact-version positive Desktop and VS Code extension project-config observations are retained without promotion. The newest CLI observation covers registered restart/recovery, unregistered and missing-remote startup refusal, unavailable-provider startup refusal, and sequential same-basename multi-project isolation. The project-config cases used explicit absolute cwd, required startup, and no fixed ENGRAM_PROJECT.
hosts.blocker: The project-local Codex adapter is render-only and must be manually merged for each absolute workspace. The standalone CLI now has partial real-host negative, provider, sequential same-basename multi-project, and restart/recovery evidence. Full acceptance still lacks a named-host linked-worktree case, credential-canary isolation, instruction-following lifecycle evidence, the managed-adapter mismatch disposition, equivalent Desktop and IDE-extension negative/lifecycle cases, and other-platform evidence. Global fixed ENGRAM_PROJECT configuration remains refused.
hosts.promotion_gate: Complete the remaining mode-specific project-context contract without global ENGRAM_PROJECT by retaining a named-host linked-worktree result, credential-canary isolation, instruction-following lifecycle evidence, an explicit managed-adapter mismatch disposition, equivalent Desktop and IDE-extension negative/lifecycle cases, and the required other-platform case. Static parsing, inventory, synthetic wrapper results, or the current partial CLI reliability receipt are insufficient for promotion.
